annotations.title: See an event website's draft (organizers only)

description: Gives the outline of one event website's DRAFT: its pages and, for one page (`page`, the home page when absent), its sections, rows, columns and blocks, each with a short id, its kind and a few words of its own text, plus the theme. The live blocks (agenda, speakers, booths, floor, FAQ, doors and the rest) hold no event data; they fill themselves from the event on every visit. `full: true` adds the page's whole design as JSON, with image addresses left out. site_edit names blocks by these short ids. Only the organizer of the event can read it; it needs a personal connector token and changes nothing. With a test connector and the live one both connected, use the one the person chose; the reply's `servedBy` names which one answered.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event name as the organizer spells it.

full.description: OPTIONAL. true adds the page's whole design as JSON.

page.description: OPTIONAL. A page id from the outline; the home page when absent.

siteId.description: The site's id as site_list gives it.

name: site_get

liveLink.description: The public address once published, null until then. While it is null, still give the organizer the address, https://sonarconnections.com/s/<siteId>, and say it is not published yet; never withhold it.
